title: Expert capacity and failure lab
description: Inject demand skew or an expert failure, then conserve every assignment through direct processing, fallback, or drop.

policies.label: Skip sparse transform
policies.detail: Overflowed assignments continue only on the residual path.

policies.label: Try second expert
policies.detail: Overflow moves to a declared compatible expert while spare capacity remains.

policies.label: Use shared fallback
policies.detail: Overflow uses a bounded general expert path before any remainder is dropped.

scenarios.label: Balanced multimodal batch
scenarios.brief: A healthy mixed batch keeps each routed expert near its nominal capacity.

scenarios.label: High-resolution image burst
scenarios.brief: Several image-heavy requests route many more assignments to vision and layout experts.

scenarios.label: Layout expert unavailable
scenarios.brief: The layout destination has zero capacity while document tokens continue to arrive.
